description: Ships structured API call logs to an external observability platform (Datadog by default) after every adapter call, whether it succeeds or fails. Captures client ID, adapter name, HTTP response status, and call latency in milliseconds. Used by platform engineering and SRE teams for real-time monitoring, alerting on high error rates, and latency dashboards. Complements audit_emit_hook which writes compliance logs locally — this hook pushes operational telemetry to a centralized log aggregation system.
use_cases: Real-time adapter call monitoring on Datadog
Latency tracking and SLA breach alerting
Error rate dashboards for adapter reliability
Debugging pipeline failures with structured log search
SRE on-call alerting for high failure rates
when_to_use: Attach to all adapters in production environments where centralized log aggregation is required. Particularly important for high-volume adapters like Twilio, Razorpay, and bureau APIs.
trigger_condition: After every adapter call (both success and failure)

input_parameters.description: Client workspace ID for log namespace segmentation
Name of the adapter that was called
HTTP status code returned by the adapter

output.on_failure: Log shipping error is non-fatal; pipeline continues
